parsed.reason: Facts are all correct and complete: tomorrow/Monday, 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM, location, title kept as PD Day, no invented details, correct AM, and it does not imply a free day. 'at the Northside community centre' is fine, but the overall feel is a notification, so it is capped at 3.
